title: Flint - MacBook pe chalne wala coding AI
content:
Ek coding AI jo aapke MacBook pe chalta hai, bina cloud API ke.
And the company says it does over 125 tokens per second.
Is model ka naam hai Flint.
Ye Recursive ka pehla model hai, aur Recursive ke CEO hain Richard Socher.
Wahi Richard Socher jo pehle Salesforce mein chief scientist the.
Flint is an open-weights coding model, and you can download it today.
Ab samjho isme special kya hai.
Model mein total forty billion parameters hain.
Par har token pe sirf around 2.5 billion active hote hain.
Isko mixture of experts kehte hain.
Matlab poora dimaag har baar kaam nahi karta, sirf zaroori experts kaam karte hain.
That is why it can be fast on normal hardware.
Company ke hisaab se, M4 Pro MacBook Pro pe 125 se zyada tokens per second.
Aur 64GB NVIDIA RTX Spark pe 150 se zyada.
Remember, these are company-reported numbers. Test it on your own machine.
Par sabse interesting part speed nahi hai.
Ye model banaya kaise gaya, wo hai.
Recursive kehta hai ki unki chhoti si team ne isko under four months mein scratch se banaya.
Unka automated research system, Eureka Machine, ideas propose karta hai, test karta hai, aur next step decide karta hai.
AI helping to build AI. That is the real headline.
Use kaise karein?
Recursive ke hisaab se ye Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp aur vLLM ke saath kaam karta hai.
Ek dhyan rakhna... full BF16 download around eighty GB ka hai, toh laptop ke liye quantized version dekho.
Use it for private code, where you don't want to send your company's code to a cloud API.
Mera take simple hai... local models ab toy nahi rahe.
Pehle ek chhote side project pe try karo, phir decide karo.
Download link chahiye? Comment FLINT and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
